Continue.description: Indicates to continue a previously failed build attempt

Help.description: Shows the help text for this build assembly

Skip.description: List of targets to be skipped. Empty list skips all dependencies

Target.description: List of targets to be invoked. Default is '{default_target}'

Verbosity.description: Logging verbosity during build execution. Default is 'Normal'

AbiGrid.description: Emit the ABI coverage grid report + gate after the platform run(s), merging sim+device

AppleVersion.description: Package version for SwiftBindings.Apple (defaults to --version when unset)

CatalystX64.description: Run on Mac Catalyst for x86_64 under Rosetta (Mono-x64 proof on Apple Silicon)

CatalystX64Jit.description: Force the Mono JIT on Catalyst-x64 (default is interpreter). Expect crashes — used to verify upstream JIT fixes

CompileOnly.description: Compile-check generated bindings only; skip app build and test execution

EnableCryptoKitSmoke.description: Opt in to the CryptoKit smoke tests (regenerates BindingTests/obj/CryptoKitSnapshot/ in-tree)

EnableLiveCommunicationKitSmoke.description: Opt in to the LiveCommunicationKit smoke tests (regenerates BindingTests/obj/LiveCommunicationKitSnapshot/ in-tree)

EnableMusicKitSmoke.description: Opt in to the MusicKit smoke tests (regenerates BindingTests/obj/MusicKitSnapshot/ in-tree)

EnableProximityReaderSmoke.description: Opt in to the ProximityReader smoke tests (regenerates BindingTests/obj/ProximityReaderSnapshot/ in-tree)

EnableRoomPlanSmoke.description: Opt in to the RoomPlan smoke tests (regenerates BindingTests/obj/RoomPlanSnapshot/ in-tree)

EnableStoreKitSmoke.description: Opt in to the StoreKit 2 smoke tests (regenerates BindingTests/obj/StoreKit2Snapshot/ in-tree)

EnableTipKitSmoke.description: Opt in to the TipKit smoke tests (regenerates BindingTests/obj/TipKitSnapshot/ in-tree)

EnableWeatherKitSmoke.description: Opt in to the WeatherKit smoke tests (regenerates BindingTests/obj/WeatherKitSnapshot/ in-tree)

EnableWorkoutKitSmoke.description: Opt in to the WorkoutKit smoke tests (regenerates BindingTests/obj/WorkoutKitSnapshot/ in-tree)

Framework.description: Apple framework name for regen-apple-snapshot (e.g. CryptoKit)

IncludeDevice.description: Include device slice in xcframework build

Lifetime.description: Run extended lifetime / GC-pressure assertions in BindingTests/RuntimeTestsApp/Lifetime/

MacosX64.description: Run on macOS for x86_64 under Rosetta (Mono-x64 proof on Apple Silicon)

MixedDirect.description: Opt-in: build a mixed (ObjC+Swift) binding in SDK-direct mode (the app's own csproj imports SwiftBindings.Sdk + <SwiftFramework>) and run it on the iOS Simulator. Sim-only; never part of the default run or --compile-only

MixedPack.description: Opt-in: pack a mixed (ObjC+Swift) binding into ONE nupkg and consume it via a single PackageReference on iOS sim/device. Composes with --sim/--device; never part of the default run or --compile-only

Permissive.description: Allow non-fatal failures in --compile-only (generator exit, dep-gen, wrapper give-up)

Sim.description: Run in iOS Simulator (Mono JIT) — default when no platform flag is set

SkipApple.description: Skip the SwiftBindings.Apple pack step (useful when shipping a Runtime/SDK/Templates-only release where the existing Apple supplement nupkg is unchanged)

SkipBuild.description: Skip all builds, just install + run

SkipSurface.description: Run the Layer B skip-surface trend gate against build/baselines/skip-surface-baseline.json

Solution.description: Path to a solution file that is automatically loaded

Swiftsupport.description: Opt-in: build a device IPA through a Swift-binding consumer and assert a compliant App Store SwiftSupport/iphoneos folder is injected (issue #42). Builds + inspects on the host; needs a code-signing identity but no connected device. Never part of the default run or --compile-only

WriteBack.description: Write probed VWT size/alignment/stride back into the manifest
